name: The Gift of Skysight
summary: On Zephras Isle, Ventaari Brightwish guides young Windshapers toward Skysight. At an Elemental Convergence, they awaken their perception and listen to the spirits.

sections.title: A Sacred Perception
sections.body: Windshapers are born with a bond to the elemental forces that shape their world. They call its sacred faculty Skysight. This gift attunes mortal senses to the spiritual realm and reaches across the divide between the living and the unseen. In the wilds, a Windshaper can call on this inner vision. Near concentrated power, the bond grows stronger, bringing boons and wisdom whispered by the spirits.

sections.title: The Convergence of Thendal Grove
sections.body: Northeast of the settlement, ancient standing stones mark an Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove. Raw energies gather at such places, where spirits linger. Ventaari Brightwish sends novices there to test their spiritual strength. Skysight grows with practice, like a faculty of body or mind. Windshapers must learn to read the elements' changing omens, for their people's survival depends on it.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Ventaari Brightwish sends novice Windshapers to an Elemental Convergence, where its power sharpens their Skysight.
Ventaari Brightwish guides and mentors young Windshapers on Zephras Isle, teaching them to honor and hone their elemental heritage.
An Elemental Convergence gathers spiritual energy, often around ancient standing stones. Elemental spirits linger there, and powers such as Skysight grow stronger.

faq.q: Where is the Elemental Convergence located?
faq.answer: The Elemental Convergence lies among the standing stones in Thendal Grove, northeast of the settlement on Zephras Isle.
A Windshaper can call on Skysight anywhere. At an Elemental Convergence, its power deepens and nearby spirits may offer further insight.

faq.q: Why is Skysight considered essential for survival?
faq.answer: Skysight lets mortals perceive elemental spirits and heed the elements' warnings. Ventaari says this sight is vital for meeting danger and preserving their people.

angles.text: As Skyborne, you inherit Skysight from elemental patrons. It anchors your cultural and spiritual identity.
As a shaman, you know an Elemental Convergence as sacred ground, where the boundary between mortal will and the elemental planes grows thin.
As Horde, you rely on the Windshapers' foresight to face Zephras Isle's unmapped dangers.
